mostWorthwhile.text: Reusing the recovered iron in marrow was most worthwhile: it connected old red cells to the oxygen-carrying protein in new ones.

leastWorthwhile.text: Growing the skin cells was straightforward and a little predictable because the picture already showed which materials went to them.

surprise.text: I hadn't expected the recycling cells to recover iron in a form carried by proteins in the blood, rather than as bits of metal.

arbitrary.text: None of the actions felt arbitrary; the pictures and chapter introduction gave each pairing a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter if it showed another connected process. The iron-reuse story was interesting, though the skin pairing was quite predictable.
